title: Warm White Italian Sauerkraut Cannoli
description: A unique Italian dish featuring white sauerkraut in a cannoli form, cooked in a tandoor clay pot, perfect for a rainy day. This recipe is onion and garlic free, making it suitable for those with sensitivities.
instructions: Preheat the tandoor clay pot to 375 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, combine the white sauerkraut, ricotta cheese, and grana padano cheese, mixing well.
Add the olive oil, salt, and black pepper to the bowl and mix until the sauerkraut mixture is well coated.
Stuff each cannoli shell with the sauerkraut mixture, filling to the top.
Place the stuffed cannoli shells in the preheated tandoor clay pot, leaving space between each shell.
Cook the cannoli for 20 minutes, or until the shells are crispy and the filling is warm.
Remove the cannoli from the pot and sprinkle with chopped fresh parsley.
Serve the warm white Italian sauerkraut cannoli immediately, garnished with additional parsley if desired.
